ns2:section.sectionText: This course provides students with foundational knowledge, strategies, and skills necessary to develop and maintain a healthy and physically active lifestyle. Students will engage in weekly, self-determined physical activity throughout the 8-weeks. This course attempts to provide students with strategies to establish and maintain healthy habits related to one’s personal physical activity. Registration for this course will close at 9 AM on the first day of instruction. No overrides will be given after that time. It takes 24 hours after registering for your name to show up on Compass but this will not happen until 1 week prior to the first day of instruction. Please contact jjenkns@illinois.edu for a duplicate override if you wish to take more than one of these sections.
